results.text: A field is not one uniform surface. John Deere connects positioning, machine displays, and field data to help farmers work more precisely. StarFire positioning helps align passes. JDLink sends equipment data to Operations Center, where farmers can review performance and plan the next job. The point is not just a smarter tractor. It is a connected operation, guided by better information.
